item.description:
Release v5.18.3

Changes since v5.18.2

  • docs(project-rag): document code navigation gaps
  • feat(lifecycle-hooks): support cancellable registrations
  • feat(message-list): hide project toolbar in empty state
  • feat(PluginLLMManager): emit LLMManagerEvent from CustomLLMManager
  • feat(project-rag): accelerate lexical search with ripgrep
  • feat(project-rag): add explicit path search
  • feat(project-rag): add lexical search fallback
  • feat(project-rag): expose search evidence kind
  • feat(project-rag): include lexical context
  • feat(project-rag): include lexical line ranges
  • feat(project-rag): index restored projects in background
  • feat(project-rag): inject code context before llm
  • feat(project-rag): merge lexical navigation evidence
  • feat(project-rag): persist chunk line ranges
  • feat(project-rag): track chunk line ranges
  • feat(project): expose shared workspace root
  • feat(ProviderLLMManager): add typed observer for LLMManaging state changes
  • feat(tool-manager): resolve relative file reads in workspace
  • feat(tool-manager): resolve workspace-relative edits
  • feat(tool-manager): resolve workspace-relative writes
